link_time_performance_minute.csv.grain: one link x one record interval (60 s) x one row, long format

columns.time_sec: integer seconds from midnight; row equals the CONTINUOUS state at t (recorded before the tick)
columns.time: HH:MM:SS, I/O display only, may exceed 24:00:00
columns.period_id: supply period at t (half-open [s,e)); FK to demand_period.csv
columns.CQ_veh|CQ_pce: cumulative arrivals at the EXIT QUEUE == CA shifted by fftt; the tandem identity CD_up(t)==CQ_down(t+fftt_down) is asserted on this column
columns.exit_queue_pce: Q(t), fluid past free-flow and not yet discharged
columns.occupancy_veh|occupancy_pce: everything on the link (in transit + queued)
columns.capacity_pce_per_hour: mu at t - per-row so the physics is auditable in the file itself
columns.exit_time|exit_time_sec: E_a(t) = t + TT(t), STORED not derived (I10)

link_time_performance.csv.grain: output_dt_sec (300 s) subsample of the minute file

adds.experienced_tt_sec: flow-weighted TT of fluid that DEPARTED the link within the bin; blank if no departures

congestion_episode_gold.csv.note: T0/T2/T3 derived from state, never from a period midpoint; QVDF/CBI+ bridge

period_boundary_audit.csv.note: I3 evidence. The two delays are t-/t+ views of the SAME continuous Q under the two mus. reset_detected is physically bounded (drainage beyond one tick of capacity), so a queue that legitimately clears exactly at a boundary is not flagged.

corridor_time_performance_gold.csv.note: model_travel_time_sec is EXPERIENCED (composed through E_a); the instantaneous sum is the naive snapshot - both emitted, clearly labelled. Compare the experienced one to INRIX.

corridor_conservation_gold.csv.note: CA_{i+1}(t) = CD_i(t) + R_on(t) - R_off(t); residual asserted <= 2e-9; requires ramps declared in corridor.csv

vehicle_gold.csv.note: largest-remainder apportionment per bin; within-bin even spacing dep = bin_start + floor(j*width/N); byte-identical reruns across hash seeds (I9)

vehicle_link_trajectory_gold.csv.grain: one (vehicle, link) traversal per row - THE audit trail, no deduplication
vehicle_link_trajectory_gold.csv.note: BOTH period ids deliberately - the rows where they differ are the demonstration that I4 works

reconciliation_gold.csv.note: demand-period accounting; clock-period accounting legitimately differs for boundary-crossing trips and is derivable from the trajectory file
